title: Dutch Oven Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: dutch oven
ingredients.notes: large, heavy pot with a tight-fitting lid

instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and stew seasoning.
In the Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove the bacon from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken breasts to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and chicken broth to the pot. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the cooked bacon.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
